item.title: Astro 1.0 Release Update
item.content:encoded: Just announced: The Astro v1.0.0 release date has been pushed back to late July.

item.content:encoded: The Astro 1.0 Beta is now available! This release marks the stabilization of all major APIs, with no more major breaking changes planned between now and the official v1.0 release.

item.title: Netlify Becomes Astro's Official Hosting Partner
item.content:encoded: We are happy to announce that Netlify has become Astro’s first corporate sponsor and exclusive hosting partner, donating $2,500 each month towards the ongoing open source maintenance and development of Astro.

item.title: Introducing Astro: Ship Less JavaScript
item.content:encoded: We're excited to announce Astro as a new way to build static websites and deliver lightning-fast performance without sacrificing a modern developer experience.
